response.sql: WITH race_avg AS (SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) AS race_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId), country_avg AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_wins) AS avg_wins FROM race_avg GROUP BY country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg FROM country_avg), above_overall AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins FROM country_avg ca, overall o WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.overall_avg), group_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS grp_avg FROM above_overall) SELECT ao.country, ao.avg_wins, ao.avg_wins - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_by, ao.avg_wins - g.grp_avg AS above_group_by FROM above_overall ao, overall o, group_avg g WHERE ao.avg_wins > g.grp_avg ORDER BY ao.avg_wins DESC;
